messages:
maria-cs: Hey team — customer (Acme Retail) reporting weird rerank outputs after yesterday's deploy. They see negative, non-normalized scores that change order-of-results between calls. Also intermittent 401s when they retry.

sara-support: ugh. Do we have a repro payload? any logs from their side?

maria-cs: They sent a minimal repro. Payload below. They say results sometimes look like raw logits.

maria-cs: ```
POST /v1/rerank
{
  "query": "best running shoes for trail",
  "candidates": ["docA","docB","docC"],
  "limit": 3,
  "normalize": false
}
```

maria-cs: Example response they pasted: `[{id:\"docB\",score:-4.12},{id:\"docA\",score:-1.3},{id:\"docC\",score:-7.8}]` — they expect [0..1] probs or at least consistent ordering.

jon-eng: quick note: the runtime returns raw logits by default for the rerank endpoint unless a normalization option is enabled or a model variant returns probabilities. Looks like `normalize:false` in their payload.

lee-ml: if those are logits, negative values are totally expected. Ordering is preserved by relative magnitude, but differing orders between calls could mean nondeterministic batching or padding shuffling. Do they include stable candidate ordering and IDs?

maria-cs: they do include IDs and say order sometimes flips on repeated identical payloads. Also they hit 401s on a few retries, and saw elevated token usage on their billing dashboard during the spike.

jon-eng: 401s mean auth token expired or rotated. Could be client-side caching plus our key rotation window. Any client SDK versions noted?

maria-cs: they use our python sdk 1.5.2. They said the SDK did a retry loop after 401 and occasionally got 502s too.

tim-prod: on the docs side: we should call out that rerank returns raw scores by default and show how to turn on probability normalization (server-side flag or client util). Also document that padding/order affects batching and can change ties.

lee-ml: repro steps for eng/runtime: 1) run repeated identical payloads with limit and shuffle off; 2) toggle normalize flag; 3) try varying batch sizes to reproduce ordering non-determinism.

jon-eng: can you attach a sample curl we can run? I'll try to reproduce locally on staging and enable tracing.

maria-cs: here: ```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \u005C
 -H 'Authorization: Bearer <TOKEN>' \u005C
 -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \u005C
 -d '{"query":"best running shoes for trail","candidates":[{"id":"docA","text":"..."},{"id":"docB","text":"..."},{"id":"docC","text":"..."}],"limit":3,"normalize":false}'
```

deploy-bot: deploy 2026-02-18T08:41:12Z -> service/runner v2.4.1 applied to cluster-rerank-03 :white_check_mark:

jon-eng: seeing similar results on staging when I set low batch_size and enable async batching — ordering occasionally differs by tie-breaking in the KV cache. I can force deterministic ordering by adding stable_sort by candidate ID before final sort.

lee-ml: we should avoid changing model outputs post-hoc. Better to expose `normalize=true` or `output:probabilities` option and clarify in API that raw scores are logits. For client SDK we can add a helper util `softmax_scores` to convert logits to [0,1].

sara-support: for the 401s: asked customer to check token TTL and SDK refresh behaviour. Also advised them to set client retries to backoff after 401.

maria-cs: customer says billing spike looks like rerank was charged per candidate tokenization on each retry. They were surprised.

tim-prod: action: update pricing docs to highlight rerank cost model (per-candidate token counts + retries). Owner: @tim-prod ETA: 2026-03-01

jon-eng: action: eng/runtime to add a deterministic tie-break path for rerank (stable by candidate ID) and also add optional `normalize` server-side flag. Owner: @jon-eng ETA: 2026-03-05

lee-ml: action: ML docs — clarify logits vs probabilities, include code snippet to softmax and note numerical stability for large logits. Owner: @lee-ml ETA: 2026-03-03

maria-cs: for now recommended workaround to customer: set `normalize=true` (if available), or run client-side softmax util; ensure candidate IDs stable, and upgrade SDK to 1.6+ which fixes a token refresh edge-case.

sara-support: customer ok with temp workaround, asked for ETA on fixes. Will keep thread open. :thumbsup:
